config.title: The Art of Kente
config.passage: Kente is a colourful, handwoven cloth from Ghana. Each pattern and colour carries meaning: gold can stand for wealth, green for growth, and blue for peace. Weavers plan their designs carefully before they begin, turning simple threads into bold and beautiful works of art.
